goal: Fix a bug where the checkout flow charges customers twice on a slow network retry.

entries.content: ran: npm test -- checkout.test.ts — 12 passed, 0 failed
read package.json — saw the dependency list and script names
grep "charge" in src/payments.ts — found chargeCustomer() called from both the initial submit handler and the retry-on-timeout handler
ran: git log --oneline -5 — recent commits about unrelated UI copy changes
read src/payments.ts — the retry handler re-calls chargeCustomer() without checking whether the original request actually failed or just timed out client-side
Found it: the retry path doesn't check for an in-flight or already-succeeded charge before retrying — that's the double-charge bug. Need an idempotency key on chargeCustomer().
ran: ls public/audio — unrelated, was checking something else earlier in the session
